name: How do I choose a contractor for accessible home modifications?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for accessible home modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience specifically in accessible design and renovation, not just general remodeling. Verify their licenses, insurance, and ask for references from previous accessible modification clients. A good contractor should be knowledgeable about relevant building codes and accessibility standards, offer transparent communication, and provide detailed, itemized quotes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with specific experience in accessible design, verify their licenses and insurance, check references, and ensure they are knowledgeable about accessibility standards.
